exposure: Hospital policy to promote early initiation of breastfeeding (EIBF) in cesarean section (CS)
cohort: The study included 2,769 postnatal mothers and their term well infants at a tertiary care institute in India.
finding: The lactation support program significantly increased the rates of early initiation of breastfeeding in both vaginal and cesarean deliveries and reduced the time to initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding rates significantly increased in both vaginal deliveries (from 92.6% to over 99%) and cesarean sections (from 0.4% to 92.7%), with a specific hospital policy further boosting rates in CS.
followup_time: Immediate postpartum (within 1-2 hours of birth for EIBF definition)
